subject: general
question:
6CO₂(aq) + 12H₂O(I) - C₆H₁₂O₆ (aq) + 6O₂ (aq) + 6H₂O(I)

Select the correct reaction conditions for a given reaction.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sunlight and chlorophyll.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The following is a basic general equation for **photosynthesis**: **C₆H₁₂O₆ = 6CO₂ + 12 H₂O + photons,** which is **carbon dioxide + water + light energy.**
 
• We are well aware that **plants serve **as a means for **recycling **our surroundings.
 
• **Technology **has made so much** CO₂** available that** plants can't handle it all.**
 
• To commercially make this reaction—which may or may not use **sunshine **and **green plants **as the only input—**feasible**, some thought must have gone into it.
 
• One may **employ alternatives **in place of avoiding either or both.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Plants **absorb **water **(H₂O) and **carbon dioxide **(CO₂) from the atmosphere and soil during **photosynthesis**.
 
• In the plant cell, **carbon dioxide **is reduced, which means it receives **electrons**, whereas water is **oxidized**, which means it loses electrons.
 
• As a result, **carbon dioxide** is transformed into **glucose **and **water into oxygen.**
 
• The plant then releases the oxygen back into the **atmosphere **after storing energy within the **glucose **molecules.
